task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 66 to 70 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "maple" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "perfect" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 3 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

reference:
Dear team,

Please keep the maple sample beside the window while the review is in progress. The group can compare the notes after lunch and choose a clear plan for the next meeting. A short written record will help everyone follow the decision and prepare the materials with care. We can share the update when the checks are complete and the room is ready for visitors.

Kind regards.
